helpCenter.acquisition.headline: Connect known resources to their files
helpCenter.acquisition.intro: A resource can have a name, links, and collection membership before you obtain its files. Acquisition uses a workflow to download or receive files, process them, and associate them with that resource.
helpCenter.acquisition.flow.title: How an acquisition completes
helpCenter.acquisition.flow.lead.title: Known source
helpCenter.acquisition.flow.lead.desc: A link, platform record, or existing server folder.
helpCenter.acquisition.flow.workflow.des: Choose a suitable workflow and run its steps.
helpCenter.acquisition.flow.receive.desc: Download direct URLs, magnets or torrent contents on the server, or wait for you to provide files in the pending processing folder.
helpCenter.acquisition.flow.library.desc: Use the workflow to extract, file away, and associate the resource.
helpCenter.acquisition.boundary: What can be acquired depends on the known source, workflow, and implemented platform support. Bakabase does not search the whole web by title. A listed link does not prove availability, ownership, or that every step can run automatically.
helpCenter.acquisition.example.title: Example: acquire a photo album from a shared page
helpCenter.acquisition.example.intro: You have a post for “Star Voyage” containing an accessible cloud-drive archive. This example uses the unchanged “Shared content and cloud drive” workflow, with you completing the cloud-drive download.
helpCenter.acquisition.example.setup.tit: Configure the receiving and storage folders
helpCenter.acquisition.example.setup.des: Open “Download settings” and enter separate server folders for the pending processing folder and resource storage. Complete these settings before starting this example.
helpCenter.acquisition.example.start.tit: Create a task from the shared-page link
helpCenter.acquisition.example.start.des: Choose “Add download task”, paste the post's URL, and select “Shared content and cloud drive”. Confirmation matches an existing resource or creates a resource awaiting files, then starts a task.
The workflow reads the shared content and selects a link. When it waits for files, open “Active tasks” to find the link and complete the cloud-drive login, CAPTCHA, and download yourself.
helpCenter.acquisition.example.claim.tit: Deliver the complete file to the server pending processing folder
helpCenter.acquisition.example.claim.des: Place the downloaded archive directly in the pending processing folder. A settled file with a clear match is claimed automatically. Otherwise, open “Pending processing folder”, find the correct task, and choose “Assign to this task”.
helpCenter.acquisition.example.finish.ti: Continue extraction, storage, and resource association
helpCenter.acquisition.example.finish.de: Claiming moves the file out of the pending processing folder. The task continues to extract it, place it in resource storage, and associate the original resource. Address any password or conflict prompts; after success, open the resource page to view it.
helpCenter.acquisition.example.defaultNo: The dialog selects the configured sharing-page default first. If it is unavailable, choose another compatible workflow explicitly. Review its current description, nodes and configuration check results.
helpCenter.acquisition.list.title: Example: import a list of wanted photo albums
helpCenter.acquisition.list.intro: “Wanted albums.txt” has two rows: “Star Voyage” with a shared-page link, and “Forest Light” with only a name. Import both into an existing “Travel albums” collection, then decide when to obtain the files.
helpCenter.acquisition.list.preview.desc: “Import resource list” reads names and links from TXT, CSV, TSV, XLSX, or XLS, one item per row. Only the first Excel worksheet is read. Correct the preview and select the rows to import.
helpCenter.acquisition.list.import.title: Files are not downloaded by default
helpCenter.acquisition.list.import.desc: Confirmation creates or matches resources and can add them to a collection. Only information is imported by default. Enable the option to create tasks for rows with links to start acquiring those selected rows. Name-only resources can be kept for later.
helpCenter.acquisition.use.title: What this connects for you
helpCenter.acquisition.use.intro: When you know what you want and have a way to obtain it, you can connect the resource record, file handoff, and subsequent organization in one task.
helpCenter.acquisition.use.identity.titl: Keep the same resource before and after downloading
helpCenter.acquisition.use.identity.desc: Record a missing resource and its collections first, then associate the local path when files arrive. Existing resource information and collection relationships remain useful.
helpCenter.acquisition.use.handoff.title: Connect manual downloads to waiting tasks
helpCenter.acquisition.use.handoff.desc: You can handle downloads from sites requiring a login or CAPTCHA. The pending processing folder hands those files back to a waiting task, whose current step and requested input remain visible.
helpCenter.acquisition.use.organize.desc: Workflows can combine existing link parsing, download, pending processing folder, extraction, and library steps. Similar resources can reuse the same steps, reducing repeated file moves and resource association.
helpCenter.acquisition.use.saveNote: “New workflow” opens an editable draft. It becomes a configured workflow only after saving. Creating the workflow does not download resources; create a task for a specific resource to run it.
helpCenter.acquisition.directory.title: Three folders, three roles
helpCenter.acquisition.directory.inbox.d: A temporary handoff folder for complete downloads. Claimed files move out.
helpCenter.acquisition.directory.working: Space managed by Bakabase for receiving and extracting a task's files. You do not enter this in download settings.
helpCenter.acquisition.directory.library: The long-term destination for organized files. The resource is associated with its folder here.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.inbox.int: The pending processing folder is a temporary folder on the machine running the Bakabase server. It hands completed browser or cloud-drive downloads to acquisition tasks that are waiting for files.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.inbox.con: Choose a folder the server can access

Enter the pending processing folder path in “Download settings” and ensure the server can read and write it. Keep it separate from resource storage so saved resources are not treated as files awaiting a task.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.inbox.tra: Place completed files directly in the folder

A browser or downloader on the same machine can save there. Downloads on another device must be transferred to the server. Only top-level files are scanned. The current page assigns one file at a time; receiving a whole folder or a group of files is not yet supported.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.inbox.cla: Match a task and continue processing

Bakabase waits for files to settle, then uses clues such as filenames to match waiting tasks. If there is no clear match, assign the file in “Pending processing folder”. Claiming moves it into the task's working folder.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.inbox.not: Container example: if the host's /srv/downloads is mounted as /downloads inside the container, enter /downloads as the pending processing folder. Your computer's Downloads folder is not uploaded automatically; transfer its files to the corresponding host folder first.
A workflow is a reusable sequence defining how to obtain, process, and associate files. The workflow definition is distinct from an individual download task.

Read the workflow description, node configuration and check results, then select a workflow compatible with the source. The new magnet default uses the built-in BitTorrent download node. Torrents accept an HTTP(S) URL or a .torrent upload.
Open “Configured workflows” to inspect existing steps, or “New workflow” to start a template draft. Save a new draft before it appears in the configured list.
Create a task for a resource
Choose a source and workflow in the resource list, then select “Acquire with workflow”. You can also start from a shared-page link using “Add download task”. The steps run after task creation.

The earlier manual magnet workflow still waits for supplied files, and saved default choices are preserved. Built-in BitTorrent workflows preserve folder structure, do not extract archives by default, and stop seeding when complete. Configuration checks do not verify links or guarantee a successful download.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.lead.name: Acquisition source
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.lead.intr: A source records where to try obtaining a resource: a saved shared page, direct file link, platform record, or existing folder. It guides execution but does not guarantee availability.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.lead.reco: Record a known address or source
Links in resource details, resources found through subscriptions, and imported lists can provide acquisition leads. A name-only resource can be kept while you find a source.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.lead.chec: The resource list shows known sources, compatible workflows, authored descriptions and configuration diagnostics. If no workflow applies or required configuration is missing, add a source or complete the configuration first.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.lead.acqu: Expired links, account access, platform limits, and required settings are checked during execution or need your attention. A link can still fail to provide the files.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.lead.note: Bakabase does not automatically search the whole web for download links by resource name. Add a link you know or provide existing files when no source is available.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.task.name: Acquisition task
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.task.intr: A task runs a workflow for one resource, recording progress, the current step, and anything needing your attention. Multiple tasks can use the same workflow.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.task.star: Open “Active tasks” after creation. Tasks may queue when the concurrency limit is reached, then execute the selected workflow step by step.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.task.wait: Supply the input a waiting task needs
Follow the task's prompt when it needs files, a password, or a conflict decision. Claiming files or submitting the requested input lets the workflow continue from that waiting step.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.task.fini: Inspect the result or failure reason
Successful acquisition associates the resource with local files. If it fails, inspect the reason in “All tasks”, fix the link, files, or configuration, and decide whether to retry.
helpCenter.acquisition.concept.task.note: Waiting for input and failing are different states. Resumable waits provide a way to continue. A retry succeeds only if the underlying problem is resolved; not every failure can recover automatically.
